demonstrated: A per-work-item execution manifest binds skill + allowed_paths before mutation.
The closeout gate BLOCKS any work-item whose changed files fall outside its manifest (exit 1, CLOSE_BLOCKED) - proven live against an out-of-scope path.
Command-hash drift and missing evidence also block closeout (see tests).
honest_limitations: The live headless run-loop (sprint_executor.py --dangerously-skip-permissions) was NOT started: (a) CCI isolation rules forbid auto-starting the autonomous ledger loop from an unrelated user task; (b) RUNLOOP-SKIPPERMS-GAP means the loop does not yet create manifests itself.
Remediation is registered as RUNLOOP-SKIPPERMS-GAP in skill-only-policy.yaml known_gaps: the loop must create a manifest per sprint and run the closeout gate before accepting work.
conclusion: The manifest+closeout contract that makes autonomous continuation ungoverned-proof is implemented and proven; wiring it into the headless actuator is the tracked next step.
